description: This file defines the EmailConfigurationAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing email configuration settings within the OrangeHRM system's admin module. It includes methods for retrieving and updating email configuration, validating request parameters, and sending test emails.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for fetching and updating email configuration settings in the OrangeHRM admin module, including validation, test email sending, and configuration persistence.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmailConfigurationService instance used for email configuration operations.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Sets the EmailConfigurationService instance to be used by this API class.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves current email configuration; returns default configuration if none exists.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving email configuration by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates email configuration based on request data, optionally sends a test email, and returns status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating email configuration data submitted via API.

methods.name: saveEmailConfigurationInfo
methods.description: Creates or updates email configuration entity from request parameters.

methods.name: setEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Populates an EmailConfiguration entity with parameters from the request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended for deleting email configuration.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rule placeholder for delete operation; not implemented.
